sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
Rose Quartz Pencil Crystal: Known as the crystal of love, self-love, emotional healing, kindness, compassion, and heart energy.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Silver-Toned Unicorn Charm: Represents magic, hope, uniqueness, positivity, dreams, and playful energy.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Lobster Lock Attachment: Easy to clip onto keys, bags, backpacks, wallets, work pouches, and travel accessories.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
Attach the keychain to your keys, car keys, bag, backpack, wallet, work pouch, or travel accessories.
Use it as a stylish everyday accessory that adds a meaningful and premium touch to your daily essentials.
Carry it with your intention for positivity, confidence, protection, love, good luck, or personal energy.
The lobster lock / hook makes it easy to attach, remove, and shift between different accessories.
Keep it with you during office, travel, college, daily routine, business, or gifting use.
Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain its shine and finish.
Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store safely when not in use.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Love Energy | Unicorn Charm | Everyday Carry

Why carry a basic keychain when you can carry something cute, meaningful, and full of soft positive energy? The Rose Quartz Pencil Crystal Unicorn Keychain brings together a beautiful Rose Quartz pencil crystal and a silver-toned Unicorn charm — made for people who love accessories that feel aesthetic, magical, and purposeful.

The Rose Quartz pencil crystal gives this keychain a soft pink crystal look with a calm and loving feel. Rose Quartz is traditionally known as the crystal of love, self-love, emotional healing, kindness, compassion, and heart energy, making it a meaningful crystal to carry every day.

The Unicorn charm adds a dreamy and playful touch to the design. Unicorns represent magic, hope, uniqueness, innocence, positivity, and believing in your dreams. Its silver-toned finish gives the keychain a cute, premium, and eye-catching look.

The lobster lock attachment makes it easy to clip onto keys, bags, backpacks, wallets, work pouches, or travel accessories. Together, the Rose Quartz crystal and Unicorn charm create a sweet everyday accessory that feels stylish, meaningful, and gift-ready.

A cute crystal keychain for everyday styling, soft love energy, and premium accessory lovers.

Note: Natural crystals may show slight variations in colour, shape, size, texture, and finish. Avoid water, perfume, and harsh chemicals to maintain shine and finish.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What can I use this keychain for?

You can attach it to keys, car keys, bags, backpacks, wallets, work pouches, or travel accessories.

Q2. Is this keychain suitable for daily use?

Yes, it is lightweight, easy to carry, and suitable for everyday use.

Q3. Is it easy to attach?

Yes, the hook / lobster lock design makes it easy to attach and remove.

Q4. Is it good for gifting?

Yes, it makes a stylish and meaningful gift for birthdays, festive gifting, return gifts, office gifting, and personal gifting.

Q5. Will every piece look exactly the same?

Natural crystals may show slight variations in colour, shape, size, texture, and finish, making every piece unique.

Q6. How should I care for this keychain?

Avoid water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals. Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth to maintain shine and finish.
